title: Research into optical-field prediction
lead: Neural models are being explored as a possible way to predict photonic fields under specified conditions.
description: This research branch is distinct from both classical solvers and the proposed ArtiSense analog interpretation processor.

sections.title: What was explored
paragraphs: The reviewed work reports field-prediction experiments with supplied boundary information. That condition matters when interpreting the result.

sections.title: Important limits
paragraphs: Prediction from scratch, larger stitched domains and a practical speed advantage remain open questions. A visually plausible field is not enough without error and generalization analysis.

sections.title: Next research tests
paragraphs: A useful comparison would hold geometry, boundary conditions, accuracy criteria and compute environment constant against a documented classical baseline.
